definitions.explanation: the state of being free from physical, legal, or social restraints

examples.japanese: {無拘束|むこうそく}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I long for an unrestricted way of life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無拘束|むこうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}いましょう→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Let's have this discussion freely without any constraints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{無拘束|むこうそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{帰宅|きたく}→帰宅：02546_kitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}された→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: After questioning, the suspect was allowed to go home without being detained.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without; non-) + ⟦{拘束|こうそく}→拘束：02803_kousoku⟧ (restraint; detention; binding). Can function as a noun or a na-adjective modifier ({無拘束|むこうそく}な). Used in both everyday and legal/political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無拘束|むこうそく}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: unrestricted lifestyle
- {無拘束|むこうそく}な⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: free discussion; unconstrained debate
- {無拘束|むこうそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰宅|きたく}する→帰宅する：22169_kitakusuru⟧: to return home without being detained
- {無拘束|むこうそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: unrestricted state

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: freedom; liberty — broader and more common; {無拘束|むこうそく} specifically emphasizes the absence of restraints
- ⟦{束縛|そくばく}→束縛：15712_sokubaku⟧: restraint; binding — the state of being tied down; {無拘束|むこうそく} is its negation
- ⟦{奔放|ほんぽう}→奔放：20059_honpou⟧: uninhibited; unrestrained — emphasizes bold, spirited freedom of action or expression
